changes: Bound cumulative CONNECT headers and connection wait; parse fragmented input without repeatedly copying accumulated prefixes.
Validate status lines and header syntax, preserve Latin-1 values, skip informational responses and accept all successful 2xx CONNECT responses.
Return bytes following successful headers to the tunnel; use a portable response replay stream for failed CONNECT responses.
Snapshot proxy configuration, validate outgoing headers and authority, normalize reserved header decisions case-insensitively and avoid mutating header providers.
Isolate proxy and destination TLS settings; close actual pending proxy sockets on cancellation, destruction, deadline or parse failure.
Exclude credentials and response header contents from debug/error messages; capture status before observer callbacks.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Replace expired 1024-bit TLS fixtures with the pinned repository's agent-base test fixture already checked into VPM (4096-bit, valid through 2035), equally for upstream and VPM.
Set HTTPS fixture URL protocols explicitly because async-listen 3.1.0 identifies Bun HTTPS servers as HTTP servers; applied equally to upstream and VPM.
For VPM only, expect the sanitized malformed-header error without reflecting proxy header contents.
